mapper.sql: p.id AS p_id, p.prescription_no AS p_prescription_no, p.patient_no AS p_patient_no, p.patient_name AS p_patient_name, p.department_code AS p_department_code, p.prescriber_name AS p_prescriber_name, p.prescription_type AS p_prescription_type, p.status AS p_status, p.prescribed_at AS p_prescribed_at, p.remark AS p_remark, p.cancelled_at AS p_cancelled_at, p.cancel_reason AS p_cancel_reason, p.created_at AS p_created_at, p.updated_at AS p_updated_at

pi.id AS pi_id, pi.line_no AS pi_line_no, pi.drug_code AS pi_drug_code, pi.drug_name AS pi_drug_name, pi.dose AS pi_dose, pi.dose_unit AS pi_dose_unit, pi.route AS pi_route, pi.frequency AS pi_frequency, pi.days AS pi_days, pi.total_quantity AS pi_total_quantity, pi.usage_note AS pi_usage_note

sql.if: AND (LOWER(p.prescription_no) LIKE LOWER(#{keyword}) ESCAPE '!' OR p.patient_no LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR p.patient_name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM phm_prescription_item pi WHERE pi.prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY pi.line_no ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phm_prescription WHERE prescription_no = #{prescriptionNo}

SELECT FROM phm_prescription p
ORDER BY p.prescribed_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{p.pageSize} OFFSET #{p.offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phm_prescription (prescription_no, patient_no, patient_name, department_code, prescriber_name, prescription_type, status, prescribed_at, remark, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{prescriptionNo}, #{patientNo}, #{patientName}, #{departmentCode}, #{prescriberName}, #{prescriptionType}, #{status}, #{prescribedAt}, #{remark}, #{cancelledAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO phm_prescription_item (prescription_id, line_no, drug_code, drug_name, dose, dose_unit, route, frequency, days, total_quantity, usage_note) VALUES (#{prescriptionId}, #{item.lineNo}, #{item.drugCode}, #{item.drugName}, #{item.dose}, #{item.doseUnit}, #{item.route}, #{item.frequency}, #{item.days}, #{item.totalQuantity}, #{item.usageNote})
